questions.answer: Immanuel Kant is a transcendental idealist.

questions.q: What did Plato affirm about reality?
questions.answer: Plato affirmed an objective and knowable reality transcending our subjective awareness, grounded in non-mental abstract forms.

triples.o: an objective and knowable reality transcending our subjective awareness

questions.q: What did Gottfried Leibniz affirm about reality?
questions.answer: Gottfried Leibniz affirmed an objective and knowable reality transcending our subjective awareness, grounded in proto-mental and concrete monads.

questions.q: What is the difference between subjective idealists and transcendental idealists?
questions.answer: Subjective idealists like George Berkeley are anti-realists in terms of a mind-independent world, whereas transcendental idealists like Immanuel Kant are strong skeptics of such a world, affirming epistemological and not metaphysical idealism.

title: Birth control

questions.q: What are emergency contraceptive methods?
questions.answer: Emergency contraceptive methods are medications or devices used after unprotected sexual intercourse with the hope of preventing pregnancy.

triples.o: medications or devices used after unprotected sexual intercourse with the hope of preventing pregnancy

questions.q: How do emergency contraceptive methods work?
questions.answer: They work primarily by preventing ovulation or fertilization.

questions.q: What options exist for emergency contraception?
questions.answer: High dose birth control pills, levonorgestrel, mifepristone, ulipristal, and IUDs.

questions.q: How effective is levonorgestrel as an emergency contraceptive?
questions.answer: When used within 3 days, it decreases the chance of pregnancy after a single episode of unprotected sex or condom failure by 70%, resulting in a pregnancy rate of 2.2%.

triples.o: decreases chance of pregnancy by 70% within 3 days

questions.q: How effective is ulipristal as an emergency contraceptive?
questions.answer: When used within 5 days, it decreases the chance of pregnancy by about 85%, with a pregnancy rate of 1.4%, and is more effective than levonorgestrel.

triples.o: decreases chance of pregnancy by about 85% within 5 days

questions.q: How effective are copper IUDs as emergency contraceptives?
questions.answer: Copper IUDs are the most effective method, can be inserted up to five days after intercourse, and prevent about 99% of pregnancies after an episode of unprotected sex, with a pregnancy rate of 0.1 to 0.2%.

questions.q: What is the recommended emergency contraception for overweight or obese individuals?
questions.answer: An IUD or ulipristal is recommended because levonorgestrel is less effective in those who are overweight or obese.

questions.q: What are the side effects of emergency contraceptive methods?
questions.answer: All methods have minimal side effects.

questions.q: Does providing emergency contraceptive pills in advance affect sexual risk-taking behavior?
questions.answer: No, providing emergency contraceptive pills to women in advance does not affect rates of sexually transmitted infections, condom use, pregnancy rates, or sexual risk-taking behavior.

triples.s: advance provision of emergency contraceptive pills
triples.o: rates of sexually transmitted infections, condom use, pregnancy rates, or sexual risk-taking behavior

questions.q: What is a fiscal year called in Australia and when does it start and end?
questions.answer: In Australia, a fiscal year is commonly called a financial year (FY) and starts on 1 July and ends on the next 30 June.

questions.q: How are financial years designated in Australia?
questions.answer: Financial years are designated by the calendar year of the second half of the period.

triples.o: calendar year of the second half of the period

questions.q: What is an example of how a financial year is referred to in Australia?
questions.answer: For example, financial year 2017 is the 12-month period ending on 30 June 2017 and can be referred to as FY2016/17.

questions.q: Who uses the financial year in Australia?
questions.answer: It is used for official purposes, by individual taxpayers and by the overwhelming majority of business enterprises.

questions.q: What options do business enterprises have for their financial year in Australia?
questions.answer: Business enterprises may opt to use a financial year that ends at the end of a week (e.g., 52 or 53 weeks in length, and therefore is not exactly one calendar year in length), or opt for its financial year to end on a date that matches the reporting cycle of its foreign parent.
